name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-paris

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search Paris Open Data for datasets by keyword (city services, mobility, trees, events, urban planning & environment). Returns dataset_ids (pass to query/dataset_info), titles, themes and record counts.

tools.name: dataset_info
tools.description: Get metadata for one Paris Open Data dataset (fields/schema, themes, record count) — call before query to learn the column names.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Query records from a Paris Open Data dataset with ODSQL. Filter (where), aggregate (group_by/select), sort (order_by), paginate (limit/offset).

where.description: ODSQL filter, e.g. `year >= 2020 AND city = "Paris"` (overrides query).

select.description: ODSQL select/aggregation, e.g. `count(*) as n, sum(amount)`.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-paris forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-paris pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
